title: ProjectionRequestV1
description: A request to project one canonical score revision. canonical_revision_id is required and names the revision the answer must be derived from, so a result can be checked against what was asked rather than trusted. instrument_profile_id is optional here because notation is fingering-independent; the requirement that TAB carry one, and that notation carry none, is a kind-dependent rule enforced in Python rather than encoded as schema polymorphism.

options.description: Ordered name/value pairs. Serialized as arrays of two strings so the request digests identically on every platform, which a JSON object's key order could not guarantee.
